name: Helical magnetic
full_name: Dexterous helical magnetic robot (articulating magnetic tip + helical surface)
group: Nelson, Multi-Scale Robotics Lab, ETH Zurich (with Cantonal Hospital Aarau)
versions: Sci. Robotics 2024; commercial successor is Nanoflex (A4 scope)
target_anatomy: neuro (aortic arch to millimetre-sized brain arteries; models and live pig)
devices_driven: own helical catheter-like robot; a news summary says under 1 mm diameter (secondary, unverified)
rotation_detail: rotation turned into advance by helical ridge on wall contact
validation_detail: models of human vasculature and blood vessels of a live pig (abstract); counts N.R.
